entries.claim_or_question: All three primary LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini API) list Pakistan as a supported country for API access and permit embedding their APIs in a commercial SaaS serving end users; all are prepaid-card funded with no Pakistan-specific billing path
entries.source_title: LLM provider availability and resale terms for Pakistan
entries.summary: OpenAI/Anthropic ✅ availability+resale with 30-day retention and no-training defaults; Google ⚠ (free tier trains on data, 18+ requirement, grounding output non-resalable); common caveat: USD card needed, Anthropic excludes entities majority-owned from unsupported regions

entries.claim_or_question: Media/utility providers workable from Pakistan: ElevenLabs (paid plans carry commercial license), Black Forest Labs FLUX API (developer owns outputs, embedding licensed), Brave Search API (licenses third-party-facing AI products at standard tiers), Daytona sandbox (no training on customer content); Tavily standard tier forbids SaaS embedding and caching
entries.source_title: Media and utility AI provider terms for Pakistan SaaS
entries.summary: Picks: BFL FLUX (images), Brave (search), Daytona (sandbox), ElevenLabs (audio). Caveats: BFL trains on I/O, sandbox vendors' ToS want written OK for third-party-serving use, Brave is postpaid with no free tier since Feb 2026

entries.claim_or_question: For messaging Pakistani end customers, Meta WhatsApp Cloud API direct is ~30x cheaper than Twilio SMS (PK SMS $0.4734/segment, one-way only); WhatsApp utility templates are free inside the 24h window; Meta Business verification requires exact legal-name match
entries.source_title: Messaging vendor comparison for Pakistan destinations
entries.summary: Pick: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API direct for booking confirmations; local PTA-registered branded SMS as later fallback. Twilio SMS to PK is cost-prohibitive and two-way unsupported

entries.claim_or_question: Stripe is not available to Pakistan-registered businesses; Lemon Squeezy (merchant of record) verifiably supports Pakistan bank payouts; Paddle markets to Pakistani businesses but publishes no seller-eligibility list; Safepay offers published local-card rates (2.9%+Rs30 domestic) with PKR settlement
entries.source_title: Payment collection options for a Pakistan-registered SaaS
entries.summary: International: Lemon Squeezy (verified PK payout) or Paddle (confirm eligibility in writing); local: Safepay (verify recurring billing). Payoneer is receiving-only (~3% PKR withdrawal fee). Feeds OD-03

entries.claim_or_question: For the API/worker/database layer, AWS ap-south-1 (Mumbai) is the only near-Pakistan option satisfying the spec's managed Postgres+Redis+KMS maturity requirement at ~$150-170/mo small-setup; Temporal Cloud is co-located in ap-south-1 with a $0-floor Developer tier; Karachi-Mumbai latency measurements conflict (~70ms vs ~200ms) so PK-ISP probes must gate the Mumbai-vs-UAE region choice
entries.source_title: Hosting platform and region comparison for OD-07
entries.summary: Recommendation: AWS Mumbai primary (UAE me-central-1 fallback pending latency probes); Render Singapore runner-up (~$75-135/mo, no KMS); Fly MPG has no Mumbai region; GCP ~1.5-2x AWS cost and PK not on its billing-currency list; Hetzner cheapest but zero managed services
